name: Imperial Naval Intelligence
description: INI field agents are Navy officers seconded to intelligence operations. Naval rank is frozen during service. Failure to qualify merely means the posting is denied — there is no permanent ban. Agents may return to Navy line/crew at their held rank at any time without a qualification roll. When mustering out, benefit rolls may be taken on the Navy table or split between both careers by terms served.

field_agent.name: Field Agent
field_agent.description: You conduct covert intelligence operations for the Imperial Navy — running assets, managing networks, and executing classified missions.

mishaps.1: An operation is compromised and you are caught in the blast. Roll on the Injury table. Lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.2: A double-agent in your network betrays your cell. Gain an Enemy and lose SOC -1.
mishaps.3: A classified mission goes catastrophically wrong and you are made the scapegoat. Lose one rank.
mishaps.4: Political interference in your operation triggers an internal inquiry. Lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: Your cover identity is burned. You are extracted and cannot continue in this role. You may return to your Navy source career without a qualification roll.
mishaps.6: A scandal — real or fabricated — forces your removal from active duty. Gain a Rival in the intelligence community.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table.
events.3: Your network is compromised mid-operation. Roll INT 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table. If you succeed, gain Deception 1 or Stealth 1.
events.4: Extended administrative work in an INI office hones your analytical skills. Gain Admin 1 or Electronics 1.
events.5: You successfully cultivate a well-placed asset inside an enemy organisation. Gain Persuade 1 and a Contact.
events.6: Deployed undercover in a hostile environment. Gain Streetwise 1 or Deception 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You manage a critical intelligence network spanning several systems. Gain Electronics 1 or Investigate 1, and D3 Contacts.
events.9: Sent on a black-operations mission that cannot be discussed. Gain Stealth 1 or Gun Combat 1.
events.10: Your intelligence work directly enables a major Navy fleet action. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll.
events.11: A coup of intelligence work unravels a major threat to the Imperium. Gain SOC +1 and an immediate promotion.
events.12: Your operation is commended at the highest level of the Admiralty. Gain SOC +1 and two extra Benefit rolls.
